name: 89183 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89183 (Las Vegas) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89183 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
